races.name: Tiptop Thunder Throne / EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mistral St Georges
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned behind the pace battle with Georgina Nicholls seeking breakthrough success.

runners_data.name: Planters Punch
runners_data.note: Front-running specialist from champion stable, but apprentice jockey Daniel Williams carries 7lb claim and pressure.

runners_data.name: Longmoor
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced type from Joe Tizzard who could improve significantly on promising debut effort, though 20 days off.

runners_data.name: Evening Tess
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who benefits from Dan Skelton's 22% strike-rate and proven soft going form.

runners_data.name: Guts And Glory
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with solid recent placings on similar ground but trainer Boultbee-Brooks winless in last 14 days.

runners_data.name: Look Don't Stare
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning recent fade pattern and Harriet Dickin's stable out of form completely.

runners_data.name: Whitletts
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong soft ground record but concerning 59-day absence and inconsistent recent form.

races.paceDynamic: Planters Punch and Guts And Glory will engage early as natural front runners, with Planters Punch the more reliable pace-setter given his consecutive wins leading throughout. The strong gallop they set should stretch the field on good to soft ground over 2 miles at Chepstow's testing track. Mistral St Georges and Whitletts can track prominently behind the leaders while hold-up horses Evening Tess and Look Don't Stare face a tactical disadvantage. This shape clearly favours prominent runners who can stay close to the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Serve It Up
scenarios.trigger: If Planters Punch and Guts And Glory clash heads early and maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will expose stamina limitations and favour those tracking just behind the early battle. Prominent runners like Mistral St Georges get the perfect tow into contention.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Henderson Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Planters Punch breaks clear early and dictates terms without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The class horse gets an uncontested lead and proves too strong, replicating his recent front-running victories. Guts And Glory tracks in second but cannot match the winner's acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire dramatically in the final quarter-mile after their early duel
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get their chance as the early pace takes its toll on front runners. Evening Tess benefits from Dan Skelton's tactical riding and her proven soft ground form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longmoor Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Tizzard runner produces significant improvement from his debut third
scenarios.body: Longmoor's inexperience becomes an asset as he travels strongly while others commit too early. His upwardly mobile profile catches seasoned rivals at their most vulnerable.

watchPoints.text: Look Don't Stare has faded badly in recent finishes and faces another tactical disadvantage from her hold-up style
Planters Punch carries favourite's pressure with inexperienced apprentice jockey potentially struggling under pressure
Longmoor represents the strongest trainer form with Joe Tizzard running at 18% strike-rate versus rivals' struggling yards
Both Harriet Dickin runners Look Don't Stare and Whitletts come from a stable completely out of form
Evening Tess is the only proven soft ground winner in the field with genuine hold-up tactical speed

runners_data.name: Ciao Bellisima

races.paceDynamic: Elated will dictate terms from the front with no obvious pace pressure in this small field of nine. Tenter Le Tout and Nowherenearmilan may track prominently but neither appears keen to force the issue early, while the majority including Molten Sea, Jollie Dame and Lakeview Lass will settle further back. This setup creates a controlled tempo that builds gradually, with the real racing beginning from the second-last flight. The lack of genuine pace pressure clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late momentum over those needing to race handily.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Elated sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash finishing kicks, while prominent racers find themselves outpaced by superior closers. Molten Sea and Jollie Dame benefit most from their tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Apply Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Tenter Le Tout and Nowherenearmilan push forward to challenge Elated before the straight
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favours horses with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike. Those settled too far back struggle to make up ground on the testing going.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Elated Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains her rhythm and kicks clear approaching the last flight
scenarios.body: The lack of serious pace pressure allows Elated to conserve energy for a sustained drive, with only those tracking closest able to respond. Late closers find themselves with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early gallop results in a messy sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as tired horses battle up the hill, potentially suiting those with recent race fitness over higher-rated but rusty rivals.

watchPoints.text: Elated's 79-day absence could leave her short of peak fitness when challenged in the straight
Tenter Le Tout's willingness to press forward early will determine whether this becomes truly run or remains tactical
Molten Sea's 5-pound apprentice allowance effectively negates her penalty and makes her well-handicapped
Lakeview Lass has faded in both recent soft ground efforts despite getting prominent positions
Jollie Dame's 11-day turnaround gives her a fitness edge over several rivals returning from longer breaks

runners_data.name: Ballybreeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist needs a strong pace to be effective, excellent similar going record but faces tactical disadvantage if pace moderate.

runners_data.name: Ostend
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from 45-day break, strong similar going form but Tom Broughton's 5lb claim suggests some question marks.

runners_data.name: Pep Talking
runners_data.note: Front runner carrying headgear changes, lighter weight and good recent form suggest connections expect improved effort.

runners_data.name: Whatyouwaitingfor
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner in excellent form, perfectly suited to track the early pace and strike late.

runners_data.name: Dj Pete
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with headgear retained, lowest weight and strong recent course form provide tactical advantages.

races.paceDynamic: Ostend and Pep Talking will clash from the gates, with both natural leaders unlikely to settle behind others. Ostend has shown recent willingness to lead while Pep Talking's form suggests he needs to bowl along in front to be effective. This dual-speed contest will create an honest tempo throughout, potentially setting up the race for those tracking just behind. The prominent runners like Koapey and Whatyouwaitingfor are perfectly positioned to benefit from this pace scenario, sitting close enough to strike but avoiding the early burn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Clash Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Ostend and Pep Talking engage in a serious early battle through the first mile.
scenarios.body: Both leaders will compromise each other's finishing kick, creating perfect conditions for the prominent trackers to sweep past in the final furlong. Koapey and Whatyouwaitingfor can time their challenges perfectly from their stalking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Ostend or Pep Talking secures an uncontested lead while the other settles.
scenarios.body: The free-running leader will dictate terms and prove hard to catch, especially with both showing recent form suggesting they can stay strongly when getting their own way. The prominent runners will struggle to bridge a significant gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely fast with multiple horses pressing forward.
scenarios.body: Ballybreeze's patient hold-up style becomes an asset as the pace collapses in the straight, allowing him to pick off tired leaders. His strong similar going record suggests he can handle these conditions when getting the right race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders hesitate or other horses unexpectedly press forward early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical and scrappy, suiting horses with tactical speed who can quicken from any position. This unpredictable scenario opens up opportunities for the most adaptable runners.

watchPoints.text: Ostend's 45-day absence could leave him vulnerable to sharper rivals despite his natural early speed advantage.
Pep Talking's headgear application suggests recent issues, monitor market confidence and early settling behavior.
Charlie Longsdon's poor 14-day strike rate (0/15) raises questions about Whatyouwaitingfor's immediate readiness despite solid form.
Tom Broughton's 5lb claim on Ostend indicates the handicapper may have found this mark challenging for the selection.
Ballybreeze needs the early pace to be genuinely strong to bring his hold-up style into play effectively.

races.paceDynamic: The Kemble Brewery will likely take them along at a steady gallop with Cosmic Connection, Authodidacte and Celtic Art all content to race prominently behind the leader. With only one confirmed front runner and several prominent racers, this will develop into a moderate pace that shouldn't suit the pure hold-up horses like Doctors Hill and Zambezi Fix who prefer stronger gallops. The lack of pace pressure early means the prominent racers and those able to travel just off the speed will have every chance to quicken when it matters. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Kemble Brewery sets a steady pace without pressure from behind
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent racers to conserve energy and time their challenges perfectly from ideal positions. Cosmic Connection, Authodidacte and Celtic Art all benefit from being able to track the pace and strike at the right moment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes even more sedate than expected
scenarios.body: The crawling pace negates the prominent racers' positional advantage and allows Doctors Hill to unleash his strong finishing kick from the rear. Zambezi Fix could also benefit from the slower tempo despite his advancing years.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If The Kemble Brewery gets an uncontested lead and none of the prominent runners pressure early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms completely and prove hard to peg back up the hill. Lacrima could also benefit if allowed to creep into contention without being asked serious questions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes overly tactical and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The stop-start nature creates a sprint finish that could suit Cornish Storm's recent good form or allow Zambezi Fix's light weight to tell. Celtic Art's experience in these conditions becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: The Kemble Brewery's fitness after 157 days off could see the front runner weaken dramatically in the final half-mile
Doctors Hill and Zambezi Fix need a genuine strong pace to be competitive but may struggle if tempo stays moderate
Cosmic Connection's prominent style and current form make him ideally suited if positioned tracking the leader early
Authodidacte's perfect recent record suggests peak form but the 123-day break needs to be overlooked
Celtic Art's recent inconsistency contrasts with his proven ability on soft ground at this distance

races.paceDynamic: Happy And Fine will take them along as the confirmed front runner, likely setting a steady gallop over this extended 2m7½f trip on testing ground. With most runners holding prominent positions rather than true hold-up styles, the pace should be honest but not overly fierce early. The Boola Boss, Buckna, and Sizable Sam will track close behind, with only Gris Majeur and Choice Runner truly held up. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick - the lack of pace pressure means those sitting handy will have first run on the limited hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine sets sustainable fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get ideal positioning to strike turning in, while the two hold-up horses have too much to do from the back. Form horses like The Boola Boss and in-form Buckna benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine gets soft sectionals and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a decisive move, with prominent trackers unable to respond quickly enough. Happy And Fine's recent course form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and Gris Majeur gets a perfect ride from Houlihan
scenarios.body: The slow gallop sets up perfectly for the two hold-up runners to unleash devastating finishes from the rear. Gris Majeur's superior recent form on good ground gives him the edge over Choice Runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Camulus Class Emergence
scenarios.trigger: If Camulus overcomes his 56-day absence and Venetia Williams' poor strike rate
scenarios.body: The hat-trick seeker's superior chase form shines through despite fitness concerns, with Charlie Deutsch getting him into contention from a prominent position. His three recent wins suggest class above this grade.

watchPoints.text: Happy And Fine could steal this if allowed to dictate soft fractions without early pressure from the prominent pack
Gris Majeur needs close monitoring - if the pace is truly steady he becomes a major threat from the rear
The Boola Boss carries strong recent form and gets weight relief, making him dangerous if tracking the leaders well
Buckna's fitness after 44 days off Warren Greatrex's yard needs careful assessment in the preliminaries
Camulus requires watching for signs of readiness after nearly two months off following his winning streak

races.paceDynamic: Presenting Doy will take the field along at a steady gallop with no natural pace pressers in this small field. I Am The Moon, Love Me, Katie's Melody and Benignitas will all track prominently but none are aggressive early types. Harmony Heights as the sole hold-up horse will be anchored at the back giving her ground to make up. This moderate tempo over an extended trip strongly favours prominent racers who can position handily and kick when the pace lifts, with hold-up horses facing a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent horses to travel comfortably into contention
scenarios.body: I Am The Moon and Love Me can position perfectly behind Presenting Doy and have more tactical speed than the leader when the race develops. Their prominent styles are perfectly suited to this race shape with no early pressure to disrupt their rhythm.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Easy Time
scenarios.trigger: If Presenting Doy gets uncontested fractions and the field allows her too much rope
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure lets Presenting Doy dictate terms completely and she proves hard to peg back despite her ordinary recent form. Her superior rating starts to tell when others can't match her sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final half-mile and becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Harmony Heights gets the collapse in pace that her running style desperately needs in this tactical setup. Her superior finishing kick under these circumstances could overcome the positional disadvantage if others stop quickly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with multiple fallers or significant interference at hurdles
scenarios.body: Benignitas or Katie's Melody could benefit from race-changing incidents that disrupt the favourites' chances. The extended trip helps their chances if the race becomes a war of attrition late on.

watchPoints.text: Harmony Heights could be virtually out of contention turning for home if the pace doesn't collapse as expected
I Am The Moon has fallen twice this season so jumping execution critical to chances despite ideal race setup
Love Me carries headgear changes suggesting recent behavioural issues that could resurface under pressure
Presenting Doy's 53-day absence could tell late if others sustain their challenge better than expected
Katie's Melody needs to overcome poor recent trainer form despite her own decent individual efforts

races.paceDynamic: Inion Tiogair will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge her early, setting a controlled rhythm over the first mile. Hillwalk and Peace In The Park should track prominently in second and third, but neither will pressure the leader significantly in the early stages. The large field of hold-up horses will settle behind this modest gallop, creating a bunched field approaching the final half-mile where the real racing begins. This shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic nightmare in a 14-runner field on soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hillwalk or Peace In The Park can track Inion Tiogair within 3-4 lengths turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace suits these prominent runners perfectly, allowing them to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kick. With most rivals needing gaps from the back, the well-positioned prominent horses avoid the inevitable traffic problems.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Inion Tiogair maintains her advantage turning in and the chasing pack fails to close decisively
scenarios.body: Her excellent soft ground record (2 wins from 15 starts) and lack of early pressure allows her to dictate terms throughout. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing surface, leaving the leader to battle home.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches turning for home with multiple hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
scenarios.body: The 14-runner field creates a cavalry charge scenario where positioning becomes crucial and several fancied runners get shut out. Those already handy or finding clear runs on the outside benefit from others' misfortune.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Horse
scenarios.trigger: If Thorgath or Shan't Wait get clear runs and the pace collapses completely in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, superior class tells when gaps appear and the soft ground becomes a stamina test. These higher-rated horses have the engine to make up significant ground if circumstances align.

watchPoints.text: Inion Tiogair could get an uncontested lead and prove impossible to peg back if no prominent runner challenges early enough
Traffic problems will be severe turning for home with 13+ runners bunching - multiple hold-up horses will get completely shut out of contention
Bushstreet Bowman and D'Gesteevo both carry fading warnings and may weaken quickly when the pace intensifies
Hillwalk has been absent 68 days but trainer Neil Mulholland's 4 from 27 recent record suggests this one is ready
Several claimer riders including Daire McConville and Harry Atkins may struggle with tactical positioning in such a large competitive field
